lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Nd4O12 (reduced formula Cs2NdO3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cs centers with eight O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Nd centers have eight O neighbors, and O environments include a square-pyramidal motif. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between square-pyramidal O polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cs and Nd coordination polyhedra.
